newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Bacnotan Cement to absorb Central Cement.
newsitem.headline: Bacnotan Cement to absorb Central Cement.

text.p: Bacnotan Cement Corp (BCC) said on Wednesday it will absorb Central Cement Corp.
In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, it said the board of directors of both companies had approved the merger of Central Cement into BCC.
Eduardo Sahagun, vice president of BCC, told Reuters the merger is expected to result in cost and operating efficiencies since both firms cater to the same market north of Manila.
The two firms have one common majority shareholder, Bacnotan Consolidated Industries Inc, he said.
He added the merger will increase BCC's yearly clinker capacity to 1.25 million tonnes from 1.0 million tonnes.
BCC said the merger will be subject to approval by the shareholders of both companies in their annual meetings scheduled on October 31, 1996.
It will also be subject to approval by the Securities and Exchange Commission. If approved, the merger will take effect on January 1, 1997, BCC said.
